objective: Reject non-finite signal-to-noise ratios during CPVS diagnostic derivation and prevent invalid magnitude-error rows from entering candidate membership.
previous_knowledge_consumed: main@b56c90bafe9e6e0c5630dd4b96c9843dbd26301c uses a negative-only threshold predicate in _qualified_ids; because NaN < sigma is false, non-finite SNR can pass the guard.
PR #237 adds an explicit math.isfinite(snr) guard and a synthetic regression test.
The CPVS exact-membership discrepancy remains independently unresolved; this guard does not establish the publisher's full selection semantics.

baseline.status: The current predicate can admit rows whose magnitude error is missing, malformed, zero, negative, or otherwise produces a non-finite SNR. The proposed fix is limited to rejecting invalid SNR values.

expected_improvement: Reject non-finite SNR values before comparing with the per-band threshold.
Retain valid finite SNR rows that meet the configured threshold.
Add regression coverage for NaN and other invalid magnitude-error inputs without changing thresholds or scientific acceptance criteria.

correctness.before: A NaN SNR could pass the threshold-only predicate because NaN < sigma evaluates false.
correctness.after: The proposed guard explicitly rejects non-finite SNR values; real source-backed impact on candidate IDs has not been measured.

evidence: Latest PR-head CI run 40657313692 passed Format Check, Lint, Cumulative Lifecycle Gate, Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, Build & Verify Package, Dependency Audit, and CI Gate.
Scientific Validation run 40657313694 passed only the benchmark/lifecycle contract stage; source-backed DR24, ALeRCE, and CPVS derivation stages were skipped because this is not a ci/heavy/* branch.
The explicit finite-SNR guard and focused synthetic regression test are present, but source-backed attribution of the two-candidate count drift has not been established.
validation.blocker: Keep this PR unmerged until a source-backed replay identifies the exact object IDs affected by non-finite SNR and verifies no unintended membership changes; separately resolve the 11,604 candidate-only CPVS discrepancy and publisher selection semantics.

root_causes: The negative-only comparison does not reject NaN values.
The first CI attempt was blocked by the repository's required cumulative lifecycle record being absent.

findings: Scientific threshold predicates must validate finiteness explicitly before applying numeric comparisons.
A successful syntax/lint check does not establish regression coverage when the test suite is skipped.
This guard does not resolve the separate 11,602-object CPVS membership discrepancy.

open_blockers: Source-backed attribution must identify whether any candidate-only IDs depended on non-finite SNR rows.
The separate 11,604-object CPVS membership discrepancy and full publisher selection semantics remain unresolved.

knowledge_carried_forward: CI on PR head be2e43c233897f422ad2241ff42639f732b2d712 passed all required CI jobs, including test suite, runtime smoke tests, package verification, and dependency audit.
Do not merge this change until source-backed attribution establishes the exact effect of the finite-SNR guard on object-level candidate IDs.
Do not claim CPVS exact reconstruction from a matching count alone.
Keep the immutable v0.2.0 scientific baseline and v1.0.1 release artifacts unchanged.
